rows.title: Product Engineer at JOIN
rows.location: Remote, any location within the -1/+1 CET time-zone range
rows.eligibility: Tier 1 - eligibility sentence is 'Work from any location within the -1/+1 CET time zone range'; Venice is CET, so he is squarely inside it
rows.comp: Not disclosed - 'open to discussing salary based on experience and expectations'
rows.why: A named Product Engineer role on TypeScript/Node + React + PostgreSQL + AWS/Docker, and the posting explicitly expects engineers to use coding agents and AI tools day to day - which is how he already works. Small product team where one person owns a feature end to end, matching his Bubble-to-Next.js/Laravel migration ownership.

'Early career' candidates explicitly discouraged - pitch the Lead Developer title. Arkipel is a product studio, so confirm JOIN is the single product he'd build on.
